$comment: Canonical machine-readable current status for Stage 2 architecture gates.
Narrative plans may explain these values, but scripts/check-architecture.mjs treats this file as the status source of truth.
stageSlices.C1 through C6 track post-authority plan/apply/test/rollback evidence separately from each slice's deploymentAuthorities entry.
Changing a value records status only; it never grants deployment authority or enables a route.
